caveat: synthetic scenes with simulated normal predictors unless stated
score_definition: image score = S_img (max leave-one-out shortfall over reliable regions); images on which the audit abstains (INSUFFICIENT) get score -inf, i.e. abstention counts as not flagged at every threshold. 'at tau' = the rule verdict is SUSPICIOUS at the calibrated tau_img (alpha = 0.05).
fused_note: 'fused' = C1+C2+C3: the shadow-pair cue C4 is manual-only (clicked in the viewer), so no automatic experiment can include it; 'fused' is therefore identical to C1+C2+C3.
localisation_note: top1_all: k_top (the region with the largest shortfall) is the pasted region, over all composites with delta >= 30; flag_correct_among_suspicious: among SUSPICIOUS verdicts, a pasted region is among the flagged ones.
